claims.claim: Reviewers note the presence of microtransactions and paid cosmetic skins while core optimization and content remain lacking.

citations.review_text: Game is very cool for what it is and plays well, but it lacks players, content and general sense of direction. Save your money for now, for this price tag its not enough. Its a prototype or a tech demo, not even an early access - its been 2 years and the game doesnt even have any settings, yet they filled the game with tons of purchasable skins. Amazing.

TL:DR Do not buy this abandonware microtransationslop filled mess

Friend of mine sent me 50 bucks to get this game. Booted into it for the first time, saw the locker option. Decide to take a look at the various customizations.

200 dollars of microtransaction slop. Every single ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ customization option is paywalled. 

Ontop of that. Sound mixing is all over the place, Gun handling feels....lackluster. Steam activity shows the last update was in December of 2025. It is now july. The moment i saw that the game had 200 dollars worth of microtransactionslop it had to really sell me on the rest. It failed spectacularly. Not only that but it also still has some major core gamebreaking bugs. Tried out the zombie mode. Died as you do. Then respawned in a wall with no way to escape the geometry to get back into the playspace. Ontop of that, there were several glaring issues with some assets just outright not loading in. 

0/10 ABSOLUTELY NOT worth your time or money.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that the game demands a strong PC setup and hardware to run properly, though some report it performs decently on mid-range cards.

citations.review_text: the graphics are amazing but the only problem for me is that i have a brick of a gaming computer but i can easily fix that by getting a actual pc but they are quite pricey for me but overall 10/10 game
To be honest, I never thought I would be able to run a game like this with a 2060, However it runs really well. and the game is really enjoyable, and fun, it is really worth the money.

This game has amazing potential. It is currently unmatched in visual presentation. The gameplay is a bit simple, it plays like a mix of old school cod, rainbow six siege, and insurgency sandstorm. But the realism and immersion is what really makes this game stand out. It has several modes available for play, including hardpoint and a zombie mode. Sound design is solid and the guns look great. 
Currently the game has no progression beyond a barebones ranking system, but this is something we will likely see improved in the future. This game has that strong "one more match" pull that keeps you playing for longer than you would expect. Lastly, the game is very demanding and requires a decent setup to play, although it's performing a lot better than I expected for an early access indie title

DO NOT BUY... if u dont have a good PC. I do have a good (ish) PC and i have run this game smoothly at MAX (epic) settings. If you are sensitive to gore and loud sounds dont by this game but you should get used to it cuz u will have so much fun with this game. DO BUY THIS GAME!!! 10/10, 5 stars.

Game is really realistic it does require some pretty decent specs if you want it to look extremely realistic but even with a mid range spec pc you will have a really fun time playing this game as it's combat is really fun!

citations.review_text: Unique shooter mechanic, despite the low FPS and the illumination glitches. High hopes for the major September update.

The game is fine, it is gets repetitive quickly but it's fun, atleast for me. There are some bugs though, visual artifacting, the gun scopes not loading in, the maps loading in too slow, and such stuff but those don't really bother me much. But, it is kind of a shame for the servers playercount, can't seem to find any full servers, on an average there are 4-7 players, mostly 4-5.

This is a great hop in/hop out shooter. The server/connection/rubberbanding issues are real tho. Barely any people so I just play Solo bots, want to get into Zombies but no Solo sadly. PLEASE GIVE US INTROVERTED PLAYERS MORE LOVE IS ALL IM BEGGING! Of course graphics are great, the realism will be next level with a few tweaks. Hope the update fixes some stuff like crazy shimmering and some serious lighting issues in certain areas. Certain dark areas will be entirely too dark or pitch black when there's sufficient enough of a lighting source nearby to at least give some illumination. I guess "adaptive exposure" is what I'm getting at? Idk the proper vernacular. Can't wait to see the future of this game. Props to the devs for getting as close to real as possible (so far)

claims.claim: Reviewers encounter technical issues including server rubberbanding, connection problems, and peer-to-peer hosts leaving or going idle.

citations.review_text:
Great concept! The execution is a mixed bag but generally good and I see there's a big update in the pipe for September with most aspects being reworked so I'm going to tentatively recommend it as I'm having a lot of fun with it. I thought it looked neat when it first came out but didn't decide to pick it up until some people whose opinions I trust recommended it. 

Pros: 

- The most realistic-feeling and looking game I've ever played and I've played a lot of these types of games. I think if you compensate for the camera sway, the realistic movement is a wee bit overdone but it does feel roughly like how firefights would play out in realistic conditions under heaps of stress, fatigue etc. I wonder what someone who has actually been in one would think. 
- The maps look like real places and gameplay footage could fool some people into thinking it's real. 
- The one-life mode ("Versus") feels excellent, definitely the highlight for me and I can see myself playing quite a lot of it.
- I don't think this movement/camera scheme is a gimmick, for me it's kind of like what Saving Private Ryan did for war and action movies. I could see similar schemes becoming a trend and a welcome one at that. I think it's cool so long as it can balanced in a way that is fun, which it is here and you do get used to it and can be somewhat nimble. 

Cons:

- P2P servers, that about says it all. Hosts tend to just up and leave or go idle and it ruins a lot of matches. I know the devs are looking into elegant hand-offs but I'd still and always prefer dedicated.
- The game doesn't have loadouts, your gear is random. This is being addressed though. 
- The game modes are a bit uninspired. I think one-life or limited respawn modes better fit the gameplay but the casual game mode servers greatly outnumber the more realistic ones. "Versus" mode is the best by a mile.  
- The maps look great but most are quite small, I'd like to see some outdoor or large maps with longer average engagement distances.…

This is a great hop in/hop out shooter. The server/connection/rubberbanding issues are real tho. Barely any people so I just play Solo bots, want to get into Zombies but no Solo sadly. PLEASE GIVE US INTROVERTED PLAYERS MORE LOVE IS ALL IM BEGGING! Of course graphics are great, the realism will be next level with a few tweaks. Hope the update fixes some stuff like crazy shimmering and some serious lighting issues in certain areas. Certain dark areas will be entirely too dark or pitch black when there's sufficient enough of a lighting source nearby to at least give some illumination. I guess "adaptive exposure" is what I'm getting at? Idk the proper vernacular. Can't wait to see the future of this game. Props to the devs for getting as close to real as possible (so far)

claims.claim: Reviewers describe the game as demanding high PC specifications or needing optimization to run smoothly, particularly in waves mode or packed lobbies.

citations.review_text: Finally, a FPS game with some realism, not the usual COD/BF arcade crap. Might need to upgrade PC spec to 100% benefit the graphics. All in all, a great game.

The game is ok, but desperately needs to be optimized. The game barely runs on a middling range PC at times, especially in the waves mode or in packed lobbies. If the game were not a slide-show in those instances, either through having a higher end PC or the game getting updated to run smoother, it would be a great game. Fair warning, though, your player character does use the weapons as if he has never held a gun in his life, so if you're looking for super high-speed gameplay that sees you as a high-end operator, you may be in for a disappointment. It's just a goofy fun run and gun game.

Game is really realistic it does require some pretty decent specs if you want it to look extremely realistic but even with a mid range spec pc you will have a really fun time playing this game as it's combat is really fun!

claims.claim: Reviewers complain about a lack of weapon loadout customization, lack of weapon attachments, and the inability to select specific firearms.

citations.review_text:
TLDR:
If you're just looking to literally jump into mindless chaos this is your jam. 

Things to improve:
- Ability to control movement speed
- Ability to customize loadouts so that you can actually take the weapons out for a spin and find you're  match.
- Different multiplayer modes, larger maps, better objectives. The audio of the objective countdown breaks immersion. 
- Suppressors? IR Lasers? Attachments? 
- RPG-like progression? I llke what's done with the stress system however it could and should be taken a step further. you can incentivize players to play more if their individual characters gain skills, stress resistance etc. I mean none of this is groundbreaking however, on this platform even small things like would take this up a significant notch.
-

This game has a boat load of potential however these limitations stop me from even finishing a round, its annoying that we can't select our own firearms let alone customize them, and it feels like the devs are hiding the ball here, as if we aren't supposed to get a good look at any particular system. Anyways.

Movement is janky as hell, You're either creeping or sprinting and both controls feel like trash. I get the asthetic of a bodycam but the game has to be somewhat playable. And yes you can "get gud" but frankly, there is zero incentive to come back to this game in its current state. No progression, No meaningful customization. It's mindless, maybe if I was 12 years old this would be sick.

I'll check back in again in another year.

A lot of potential with a game like this. I am happy with it so far but I'm excited to see what the devs decide to add mapwise and game mode wise. It would also be nice to be able to customize a loadout at some point as well (primary/ secondary weapon, and sights specifically)

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the game lacks content updates and that previously available maps, such as a forest map, have been removed.

citations.review_text: Game has barely been updated in two years, devs promised way more then they could actually handle.

If you are wanting to buy this game, don't, go watch a five minute youtube video and you will see everything that there is to offer. If you are looking for a game where you die in about 30 seconds on any map with maybe a kill each life then it's a fine game but that isn't really fun for many people including myself it seems. The only maps that are in the game are all just CQB slop... The devs don't ever seem to update the game even though there are roadmaps and announcements once every few months, but nothing ever happens. The only updates in this game make it worse. The only thing the devs do with their updates seems to be just removing things with little to no information about whats happening with them. There have been multiple maps that made the game actually fun, like the forest map that has been completely removed with the devs saying that it is being reworked but haven't been seen or mentioned in months, possibly even years now, I have lost track... For the price that you have to pay it is very much not worth it either. This game feels like you are playing an unfinished pre-release demo with very few players and almost empty lobbies. The game does have a lot of potential to be great with more updates and bigger maps but as it sits, it's just not.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that control schemes, aiming behind cover, and controller support feel clunky and frustrating at first.

citations.review_text: BY FAR THE MOST IMMERSIVE AND IMPRESSIVE SHOOTER/FPS IVE EVER PLAYED! HIGHLY RECOMMEND PLAYING THIS GAME, FRUSTRATING CONTROLS AT FIRST BUT I PROMISE IT GETS SO GOOD ONCE YOU GET THE HANG OF IT! GLHF!!!

This game is genuinely fun! For me it was worth the money even just to support the Dev teams genre evolving innovation (I know it sounds hyperbolic, just get it and try... or watch some gameplay.) Highly recommend, this game has the potential to actually inspire the FPS genre.

This is the kind of Dev team that deserves the AAA budget, they are actually innovating on the formula in a way that is actually impressive. The fact that they achieve a photo-realistic image that runs on modern hardware is something the industry could learn from. The new tech for the player rig and dynamic animation flow is awesome, you just have to try it to understand. I highly recommend checking out their dev logs on youtube, they are excellent at communicating the information. 

The game has controller support but it feels very clunky, it just needs some tuning and a few more knobs to tweak like an ADS sensitivity independent from the global sensitivity. It also needs a layout config for controllers. All of this im sure they are going to add, but just know its not there yet.

There are a few map issues, but they are not unique to this game, spawns are an issue. You can (on the small maps) often end up in a situation where enemies will spawn directly in front or behind you.

I've been waiting for a game that feels modern, next level and to also bring back the excitement of playing a FPS. I love the may the best team win aura the game has to it. It definitely has a competitive drive to it.

The shadows from people shooting are amazing and I love the realism of the maps. 

The only cons I see is that they should add matchmaking dedicated severs rather than people hosting as I've gotten kicked a few times (I believe)

also trying to zoom in behind cover can be a bit janky where my gun wouldn't aim in. 

I'm looking forward to the loadouts and for whatever is coming to BODYCAM

I'm 100% here for the ride!

citations.review_text: Barely any updates. Road off the hype of another game and now the genre is basically nothing. I'd like to start by saying I NEVER make reviews for games long because it's boring, but this game is very special to me so I'm writing this hoping the developers see this give a response.

This game has scratched a itch that I have had for a very long time. Casual tactical fun. Boot it up, spawn in with a random loadout, and watch as you slowly lean into the monitor trying to clear cluttered dark rooms, praying no one is inside their with you. In a market where remasters and sequels being grown on trees, it's beyond refreshing to find a FPS game that doesn't shove limited time events and modes down your throat, making the game feel less like a job and more like entertainment for when your craving that sweet gunplay. It's also one of the first games that i can think of that tried the free aim style of gameplay and it is definitely the best in its genre. So why leave the bad review?

The team has mismanaged communication. The last major update was awesome, the village zombie map is terrifying and hilarious with friends, but that was almost a cool, crisp, 365 days ago. And if you see under the activity of the games page, they dropped a road map to fill us in because of the issues with going radio silent. It is a massive list of tweaks and new features like: ui, audio, weapon mods, animations, and explosive rc cars? This seemed very promising and better yet, some of these were supposed to come with the May update. Now it is about to be August. And without them saying a word, it feels like they just dropped the game entirely or at the very least they aren't showing their work to us. To let us know you are working on the game we would need a dev log, maybe a video of a new mechanic once or so a month, anything would be something, but no. Only silence.

To add a bit of sulfuric acid to the injury, a lot of things that they have added are removed including maps, game modes, and the illusive in-depth character customization. So if you love a certain map and game mode …

citations.review_text: Feeling dull playing first person? Challenge yourself with Bodycam for a while an go back if you'd like or as I have, I've sided with this game in particular seeking other games related to. Occasionally going back to classic first person feeling I've improved. I'd like to say, bigger maps and a few more game modes are more than welcome. Perhaps try eliminating the feel of small map when there's spawn kill. (sometimes) Feeling like a bad CoD map. Spawn kill, kills the joy of any game. Oh and most of all, more guns please.

I've played the game quite a bit. While I do very much enjoy it, I can't recommend it in it's current state. I will list off the most egregious issues that have been plaguing the game for far too long:

- Inability to choose which weapons/no loadout system
- Server menu does not accurately list what servers are available or what maps are being played on. I can try to enter a match and be kicked out because it's full, despite the menu showing otherwise. Even if I get into a lobby, there's no guarantee that the map it's listed as will be the one you'll be playing on.
- There are no messages that explain why you got kicked from a lobby. You have no way of telling if it was from lag, the host leaving, teamkilling, the host kicking you specifically, etc. 
- You can't customize the sights on guns. There are several guns that have godawful iron sights and they're very difficult to use. Some of them don't even have any optical variants to speak of. Because the selection of guns is random every time you spawn, so are the sights. 
- Spawning issues. There have been many times in team gamemodes where the entire team keeps spawning on top of each other in the same exact spot. God forbid someone is AFK and you can't move. 
- You can barely customize lobbies. You have no say over what guns are in play, what sights can be used, no ability to fix team imbalance, can't set a time limit, etc. 

Some of the more minor issues include: 
- Music settings don't seem to work. I have it turned completely off, yet my ears still get blasted with that stupid ass welcome music every time I load up the game
- Maybe it's just me, but penetration through wooden walls needs to be fixed. It rarely seems to work
- If you try to enter a game and are immediately kicked out because it's full, the game for some reason decides to do it again even though you're not in a lobby? As in I will be back in the menu and it turns the screen black and makes the kicked sound effect. 

All that being said, the gunpla…

claims.claim: Reviewers state that there is no loadout system, forcing players to spawn with random weapons and fixed iron sights.

citations.review_text:
The only good thing about this game is the graphics. Everything else is very boring and half assed. 

1) Firstly, the servers and lobbies are absolute trash. You either get kicked after being in a game for 5 mins or you cant even join a game. And not to mention they are mostly filled with bots.

2) Secondly, there is no way to progress in the game. You just join random lobbies and shoot people. There is no levelling up or unlocking or customizing. You loose interest after playing for like 80 hours because its rinse and repeat with absolutely no progress made. 

3) Thirdly, they just want mirco-transactions. The store is filled with crappy skins for like $2 each.

4) The zombies is okay. The fact that you have infinite ammo and can carry like 10 guns makes it way too easy and unrealistic.

5) Lastly there is no loadouts... so you spawn with a semi automatic in super close quarters... 

Overall the game is okay. Not worth the price. Maybe if they add progression, fix the servers/lobbies, and add some sort of loadout , then the game might be worth the price.

Devs killed the game.
0% gameplay, barely any updates. just empty updates.
Player hosted game, so if host gets mad because he's loosing. he can just end the match.

Random weapons, you can get a battle rifle without a sight or even iron sights. Sometimes you get nothing exept a grenade, the whole other team gets weapons.

you can buy skins for real life money, there isnt a weapon buy system or anything like it.

voice chat is ♥♥♥♥♥♥, has been since launch. everyone is super quiet.

Update vice there has been 0 changes for improving what the community wants or needs fixed. 
majority of updates is just small bug fixes. Oh but here is another zombie map...

Cashgrab. 0% gameplay, only for looks. dont buy. Devs too young for this kinda project. 
The $40m probably went to their pockets instead of development. and when people are asking they just say "oh we are bound to a NDA, but trust us, something is happening" since launch.
